title: Motion-Picture Equipment (16-mm) - Camera Spools - 50- to 400-Ft Capacity
scope: 1.1 This standard specifies the dimensions for 16-mm motion-picture camera spools having capacities from 50 ft to 400 ft (15 m to 120 m) of film. 1.2 This standard further specifies the configuration of the positioning of the spindle holes in the two flanges. These shall be identified as styles 1, 2, and 3 (see figure 2).
